name: chatgpt-stream-proxy
description: My attempt at a basic open ai api proxy
author: emmaalecrim <emmaalecrim@gmail.com>

scripts.deploy:build: gcloud config set project truenation-dev && gcloud builds submit --region=global --config cloudbuild.yaml
scripts.deploy: gcloud config set project truenation-dev && gcloud builds submit --region=global --config cloudbuild.yaml && gcloud run deploy glasswall-ws --image europe-west2-docker.pkg.dev/truenation-dev/glasswall-ws/main
scripts.deploy:prod: gcloud builds submit --region=global --config prod-cloudbuild.yaml && gcloud run deploy glasswall-ws --image europe-docker.pkg.dev/truefilter-10000/glasswall-ws/main
